subject: Warm pass: BioVera - implementation intake & kickoff options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@biovera.io>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Warm pass: BioVera - implementation intake & kickoff options

Hey Monica / Tessa — looping you in to hand off BioVera (Sarah Kim) for post-sign work. Quick summary below, followed by a proposed 45-min kickoff window options.

Deal context: BioVera is a mid-market medtech analytics startup. Signed a Dedicated plan (4 reserved GPUs) with a 12-month commitment; deal approved week of 5/24. Procurement routing expects standard Redwood DPA and a single PO.

Key goals for first 30 days:
- Pilot ingest of 2 clinical datasets (CSV export) and a small embeddings pipeline for search.
- Integration with their in-house KMS for key wrapping (they want HSM compatibility notes).
- End-to-end demo for their clinical product lead + infra.

Known constraints / risk:
- They require VPC peering + static egress IPs; their network team requested a tentative blocklist by kickoff.
- Expect some SOC2 evidence requests (security questionnaire already attached).
- Go-live target: 2027-07-15 (aggressive but realistic if sprint 0 completes on time).

Attachments I pushed to them: BioVera_SOW_v0.3.pdf (SOW with milestone payment schedule), network-requirements.xlsx, mutual-action-plan.docx.

Kickoff options (45 min):
- Wed 6/2 10:00-10:45 PT
- Thu 6/3 14:00-14:45 PT
- Fri 6/4 09:00-09:45 PT

Customer attendees: Sarah Kim (PM), Raj Patel (Infra), Procurement (cc: procurement@biovera.io).

Asks for CS intake: can you nominate a primary and secondary steward? Also please confirm whether we need Redwood infra present for network Q&A (I can bring Karthik for the initial 15 minutes).

Marissa
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0183

Attachments: BioVera_SOW_v0.3.pdf (attachment); network-requirements.xlsx (attachment); mutual-action-plan.docx (attachment)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@biovera.io>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 12:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Warm pass: BioVera - implementation intake & kickoff options

Thanks Marissa — great context.

I'll take primary stewardship for onboarding and run the Sprint 0 cadence. Tessa will be backup for staffing and vendor coordination.

Immediate next steps from CS side:
1) I'll review the SOW and post a concise intake checklist in the shared Drive by EOD today.
2) Need the following from the customer before kickoff: network contact details, a list of service accounts that will access Redwood, and their preferred SSO provider (Okta/Azure/GCP).
3) Propose sprint 0 scope: baseline ingestion, test inference pipeline with stubbed data, and basic dashboard for results. Estimated effort: 3x internal sprints (2 weeks each).

Availability for kickoff: Thu 6/3 14:00 PT works best for me — locking that unless Sarah requests otherwise.

Marvellous — will also add an operations pre-call (internal) 30 minutes before kickoff to align owners.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

Thanks Monica — confirming Thu 6/3 14:00 PT for kickoff. Sarah, we've scheduled 6/3 14:00-14:45 PT for the joint kickoff. Please let us know if that conflicts with anyone on your side.

I uploaded the latest SOW and a redlined summary to the shared Drive (link below). Also adding a short checklist of pre-kickoff asks for BioVera:
- Network point-of-contact + IP allowlist for peering testing
- SSO provider and an Okta metadata file if applicable
- Example CSV export (anonymized) for the sample ingestion test (<= 500MB)
- Preferred billing contact and PO number if available

Internal note to CS: Karthik will attend first 15 minutes to review the billing/payment milestones in the SOW and to answer any procurement questions.

Shared links: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/BioVera-Intake
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345678

Marissa

Thanks — Thu 6/3 14:00 PT works for our team. We're aiming to have Raj (infra) and I on the call; procurement will likely not attend the kickoff but will follow up on PO paperwork after SOW sign-off.

I've attached a short network contact sheet and a small sample CSV (anonymized) for the ingestion test. For SSO we're on Okta; I'll share metadata with Monica before EOD tomorrow.

Also: a couple of clarifications for the SOW line items — can we align on the acceptance criteria for the first milestone (ingest + embeddings + demo)? I'd prefer explicit pass/fail checks (sample size, latency targets, and a checklist for data redaction). Happy to sync for 15 minutes in the ops pre-call if that helps.

Thanks,
Sarah Kim
Product Lead, BioVera
sarah.kim@biovera.io
